phrase.zh: 同一世界，可以有两种读法。
phrase.en: One world can be read in two ways.

visual.zh: 铜色细带以三个宽阔波峰横贯画面，暗色背面与微绿边缘交替出现；细点沿中部散开，上下留出浅色空白。黑白版保留同一波形与粒点。
visual.en: A copper ribbon crosses the frame through three broad crests, with dark undersides and a faint green edge. Sparse dots run along the middle, between quiet pale regions. The neutral edition keeps the same wave and dots.

background.zh:
德布罗意获1929年诺贝尔物理学奖，因发现电子的波动性质。他在1924年提出用波来描述电子的想法。铜带与粒点是表现波与粒子两种描述的原创寓意，不是电子的真实轨迹或实验数据；短句为原创。
1929年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他发现电子的波动性质。
background.en:
De Broglie received the 1929 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering the wave nature of electrons. He proposed a wave description of electrons in 1924. The ribbon and dots are an original metaphor for wave and particle descriptions, not an electron trajectory or experimental data. The phrase is original.
1929 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his discovery of the wave nature of electrons
